title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: modernised Gallery view prioritises video on stage
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's default Gallery behaviour, rollout notice and Teams Rooms licensing. The portal route matches Microsoft Learn, and the remaining gaps are limited to the Gallery setting's exact labels, local navigation and automation.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The release notes list modernised Gallery view in Android build 1449/1.0.96.2026249711, September 2026.
claims.quote:
### 1449/1.0.96.2026249711 (September 2026)
Introduced in this update:

claims.claim: Features may become available on a device make and model later than Microsoft's release.
claims.quote: There can be a delay between when features are released by Microsoft and when they become available on a device make and model.

claims.claim: Microsoft directs administrators to the device manufacturer if an update is not available on their device.
claims.quote: If an update isn't available on your device, check with your device manufacturer for information on when it might become available.

claims.claim: Microsoft identifies organisations using Teams Rooms on Android devices as affected.
claims.quote: Who is affected - Organizations using Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android devices.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft says no action is required before rollout.
claims.quote: No action is required before the rollout.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends communicating the visual changes if the organisation provides end-user training or adoption materials.
claims.quote: Communicate these visual changes to Teams Rooms users if your organization provides end-user training or adoption materials.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: MC1446797 identifies no compliance considerations.
claims.quote: No compliance considerations identified.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap description nor MC1446797 describes new data collection or storage.
claims.quote: This update aligns the experience more closely with Teams Rooms on Windows by improving participant visibility, creating more consistent layouts, and providing additional meeting display controls for users and administrators.

claims.claim: The feature descriptions do not describe an identity, permission or sign-in change.
claims.quote: Users can hide the room self-preview video and choose to see audio and video participants equally on stage, instead of prioritizing video participants. Admins can choose the default behavior using local device settings and the Pro Management portal.

claims.claim: The feature descriptions concern participant arrangement and display choices, not autonomous actions.
claims.quote: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage.

claims.claim: Portal settings management is available only for signed-in devices.

claims.claim: Schedule Later applies settings in the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.claim: No separate price for modernised Gallery view is published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android modernized Gallery view license price meter; "Modernized Gallery" "license" "price". Read rooms-licensing and rooms-release-note; neither names a separate Gallery price.

claims.claim: No meter for modernised Gallery view is published as of November 2026.

claims.claim: No licence specific to modernised Gallery view, separate from the published product entitlement, is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android modernized Gallery view license price meter; "Modernized Gallery" "license" "price". Read rooms-licensing and rooms-release-note: product Gallery entitlement is documented, not a separate licence for this update.

claims.claim: The documented generic portal route is Rooms / Phones > device > Settings > settings category > setting.
claims.quote: Go to Rooms/ Phones in the left navigation and click the device you want to configure. Select the Settings tab in the device panel. Use the left navigation in the device panels to browse settings categories (About, Account, Meetings, Device, Network, etc.).

claims.claim: No API, PowerShell or Graph call for configuring portal device settings is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management portal device settings API PowerShell Graph configure settings; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/teams Gallery Android device settings Pro Management. Read pro-portal-settings; Graph-targeted search also found no applicable operation.

claims.claim: Teams Rooms on Android devices can be enrolled in the Pro Management portal for central management.
claims.quote: For Teams Rooms on Android devices or Teams panels, the admin agent included on the device automatically connects to the Pro Management Portal. Devices once signed into Teams automatically enrolls and appears in the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal.
